term: selected-world necessary support and underived essence identity
definition: ActualNoContingent restricts the existing no-contingent-supporter condition to w. ActualNecessarySupport m R w c n is NecessaryAt m w c ∧ NecessaryAt m w n ∧ PresentEsseSupport m R w c n; ActualNecessaryWellFounded is its well-foundedness. ActualUnderivedEssenceIdentity existentially conjoins actual presence, NecessaryAt, NoExistingSupportAt m R w n (absence of actual existing R supporters), and Profile essence–esse equality for one same bearer.
note: A deliberately weaker scope than NamedNecessarilyUnderived and UnderivedEssenceIdentity. No actual reflexivity, cross-world edge transport or all-world supporter exclusion is implicit. The necessity notion and typed q3 profile retain their existing meanings. These restrictions are analyst stipulations, not attributed historical premises.
